payload.priorities: Prove persisted configuration, authorised end-to-end journeys, payroll integrity, tenant isolation and recovery without weakening any mandatory release gate.
payload.notes: SYNTHETIC PROOF ONLY. Two-person UK test scenario, using the previously observed Tamworth fixture import. The company name and country selection define a test case, not verified customer facts. No genuine provider connection, payroll policy, customer contract or approval is asserted. Blank payroll, ERP, work-pattern and clocking inputs are unresolved, not not-applicable. This small scenario does not replace the global/all-size proof matrix. No production, security, recovery, competency or release gate may be closed from this form alone.

executionPreconditions: Use supported authorised form/session access; no credential retrieval or authentication bypass.
Recheck exact candidate identity, fixture-only boundary, current imported employee count and northstar-demo tenant before any write.
Do not overwrite another actor's different or approved scope. Use a single authorised writer.
Submit only the payload through the existing form; preserve readback, refreshed UI and fresh-session evidence.
Prepared inputs and form acceptance must not be promoted to customer-ready or provider-acceptance evidence.
